dominant_strengths: Clean hierarchy with disciplined section labels (RECENT, NAVIGATION, ACTIONS) and consistent two-line item structure aiding scannability.
Selected-row treatment uses a soft violet wash with a left accent edge, signaling focus without overpowering the dark canvas.
Footer keyboard-hint row (navigate/select/close, CMD+K) demonstrates native command-palette literacy and behavioral clarity.
dominant_weaknesses: Icon tiles feel generic and slightly mismatched in stroke/fill weight, weakening craft and making the palette read as templated.
Color story is safe—near-monochrome slate with one violet accent—lacking distinctive personality versus Linear/Raycast peers.
Secondary descriptions are low-contrast gray on dark, hovering near accessibility thresholds and muddying the type rhythm.
fix_priorities: Redesign the icon set with a unified geometric system and restrained accent color usage per category.
Lift secondary text contrast and tighten the type scale between title and description for clearer rhythm.
Introduce subtle motion or a result-count/empty-state affordance to elevate reflective and visceral pull.
Add a distinguishing signature element (badge, shortcut chips, or grouping divider) to escape the generic palette archetype.
rationale.norman_balance: Behavioral execution is strongest; visceral appeal is competent but unmemorable, and reflective resonance is limited by lack of a signature idea.
rationale.intent_fit: Yes—it is a recognizable, functional command palette, but it stays squarely in 'original/baseline' territory without distinctive moves.
